name: @miragon/pulse-migration-plan
description: The migration plan file format of Pulse: the types of a plan that names one BPMN process by its id and two of its versions by their numbers with one to one element mappings, a parser that takes the text of a .migration.json file and returns the plan with its notes or the problems of a file that gives no plan, each a code with its JSON path, the words of those problems, the one writer of a plan's text, the file names, the id and version rules, the rule that resolves a version number to exactly one definition, the JSON Schema for editors and the shared fixtures. No engine, no instance and no runtime dependency; the CLI and the editors bundle it.
